hardware_and_scope.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, nominal 8 GB dedicated memory
hardware_and_scope.quality_scope: The compared arms used the same settings. Per-frame internal render size and pixel equivalence were not established. Host Present is a software event; scanout was not measured.
hardware_and_scope.timing: Milliseconds unless a field states otherwise. Each experiment has its own denominator; do not add costs across runs.

gpu_19_dispatches.test: Comparison across independent game processes. All 19 ordinals, full shader IDs and dispatch group triples matched; 768 MiB buffer pool cap. The policy reserves headroom for larger buffers. GPU timestamps bracket individual dispatches.
gpu_19_dispatches.limit: Legacy captures admitted lists over 50 ms only. The new sparse sampler used a different gate. These matched samples do not establish an unconditional workload distribution, identical resource contents across runs, a WDDM migration event or a frame-rate gain.

hot_present_window.window: First 240 host Present intervals after hot resource anchor, diagnostics enabled
hot_present_window.limit: Single anchored run, with diagnostic overhead and variable scene load.

map_clear_batch_582.measurement: One real game mapper batch. API times are thread wall time including waits and preemption; restored fragments include their Map calls.

native_clear_replay.test: Rebuilt identical ordered mapper history from 682 game batches; A leaves individual clears separate, B combines touching zero-source clear requests. Six paired timings on Windows. Measurement covers native mutations and survivor repairs, excluding decoding, pre-grouping and verification.
native_clear_replay.limit: Native replay did not reproduce the long game-thread stall. Some equivalent backing layouts differ in Windows allocation region boundaries.

live_clear_coalescing_baab.test: Same binary, warm cache, settings and input script. A is reference; B combines adjacent clear requests. Each arm counts 240 host Present intervals after the first hot binding.
live_clear_coalescing_baab.limit: Fixed interval count did not fix scene workload. No matched hot clear-heavy frame pair (at least 256 requested pages).

unmap_thread_states.test: Independent diagnostic process; sample query bracket wholly inside the same thread's successful native Unmap, in qualifying hot clear-heavy batches (at least 100 ms and 256 requested pages).
unmap_thread_states.limit: Duration-biased point observations. No exact repeat of original batch 582; neither per-state dwell milliseconds nor lock owner were identified.

fingerprint_dual_read.test: Read-only observer in the registered 16 GiB window. Compare the original sampled ranges byte-for-byte against backing aliases or established holes while the mapping generation is stable. Counts are calls except where noted.
fingerprint_dual_read.limit: Cohorts overlap. Unresolved calls have no equality verdict. All original host operations still ran; the direct timing bracket is not a measured saving or proof that views can be removed for all readers.

submit_and_gpu.test: Separate heavier diagnostics run, fully paired direct queue timestamps and host Present return intervals. The descriptor wait is matched against overlapping worker scanning brackets in the same time base.
submit_and_gpu.limit: Direct stamps can include queue work other than shaders. Time before next send does not prove whole-device idleness. Worker brackets include potential waits. No live A/B of earlier descriptor requests.

readback_granularity.test: Reconstruct the post-dispatch image from one before/after pair, relative to the observed buffer view.
readback_granularity.limit: Payload estimate only; excludes comparison, metadata, commands and waits.

redundant_upload.test: In eight consecutive live buffer versions, pre-copy source and target were equal for all 21,045,760 bytes in each. Separately, reran the original dispatch from fixed input with and without one redundant upload.
redundant_upload.positive_control: Changing one source byte made an unconditional skip fail verification.
redundant_upload.limit: No cheap runtime version proof or measured live-frame improvement follows from this control.

cpu_read_gpu_upload.test: Fixed dispatch and source, alternating pairs. Host read timing after fence covers Map, memcpy and Unmap. Default path DMA to a readback resource occurs before that host-read bracket.
cpu_read_gpu_upload.limit: Only the measured CPU read direction, fixed buffer and tested adapter. No frame-time measurement.
